481.title: Warning Sign
481.content:
Attention: The following dangerous actions are strictly forbidden in the Skyrealm Forest:
1. Jumping from heights while wearing a hood.
2. Hiding in bushes and whistling.
3. Looking out into the distance from a tall tree.
